brand.tagline: ONE WORLD. MANY PERSPECTIVES. NO STORY IS WRITTEN IN ADVANCE.

hook.question: THIS TIME, YOU ARE CAESAR.
hook.visualCue: Caesar approaches the Senate steps while the crowd opens around him; an understated ten-minute countdown sits in the upper corner.

rewind.label: GO BACK.
frames: A warning tablet falls beside the Senate steps.
The tablet returns to the messenger's hands.
The messenger crosses the forum toward Caesar.

player.visualCue: Caesar in pale daylight, composed but alert, receiving a sealed message before the Senate session.

lines: YOUR CLOSEST ALLY MAY BE TELLING THE TRUTH.
OR HE MAY BE SETTING A TRAP.
conflict.visualCue: Caesar examines the sealed warning while Brutus and Antony appear as distant, uncertain figures.

choices.label: ENTER THE SENATE
choices.strategy: Reject the warning and preserve your public confidence.

choices.label: ARREST CASSIUS
choices.strategy: Act openly against the suspected conspiracy before evidence is complete.

choices.label: PRETEND YOU KNOW NOTHING
choices.strategy: Delay the session and quietly observe who changes position.

consequences.visualCue: Brutus watches Caesar change course without knowing whether he was trusted.
Cassius reads the delay as danger and signals the conspirators to act sooner.
Antony receives an instruction to keep the guards near but out of sight.

productMessage: EVERY DECISION RESHAPES THE SAME ROME.

captionVariants: Ten minutes before history changes. This time, you are Caesar.
Brutus warns you. Do you trust him—or test him?
A single delay changes every player's next move.
